title: One Outline row when a shape and a picture are picked together
goal: Pick a rectangle and a screenshot at the same time and the settings panel shows two rows both called Outline, because the two draw their ring in different ways underneath. A person sees one duplicated setting. Make it one row that reaches both.
notes: From the shape-parts work on 2026-09-06 (docs/design/shape-parts.md). A shape paints ColorSlot.stroke, everything else paints ColorSlot.border, and ColorStyleSelection plus the whole saved-styles path is keyed by slot, so one row cannot yet read or write both. PhotonzCore/LayerParts.swift builds the two rows; each carries a reachNote so nothing is silently lost today.
acceptance: Picking a shape and a picture together shows exactly one Outline row
Its tick switches the ring on and off for both kinds in one step
Its colour paints both kinds in one step
Its Width sets both kinds in one step
A single selection of either kind is unchanged

log.note: duplicate of two-layers-picked-together-are-offered-outline-t, which shipped exactly this on 2026-09-07: one Outline row over both kinds of line, with its switch, its colour and its Width reaching a shape and a picture together. Audit queue/audits/2026-09-07-one-outline-two-kinds.json.
